title: Kaisi Ye Shaam Aayi
body:
kaisi ye shaam aayi aulaad e sayyeda par
sajjad ro rahe hai zainab se moo chupa kar
<<DIVIDER>>
ek samt be kafan hai bhai ka uske laasha
abbas ki behan ka baaqi raha na parda
ab sochti hai zainab maange kafan ya chadar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
baazu kahin pade hai laasha kahin pada hai
zainab ki bebasi pe par ghazi tadap raha hai
roti hai bekasi bhi farsh e aza bicha kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo ghar may do qadam bhi paidal nahi chali hai
ek din may wo hi zainab abbas ban gayi hai
pehre pe aa gayi hai tanha alam utha kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad se lipat kar kehti rahi sakina
ehsaas ho raha hai mai hogayi yateema
zaalim dara raha hai naiza dikha dikha kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashon ke darmiyan wo baba ko dhoondhti hai
moo apna peet kar ye faryad kar rahi hai
qadmon may hi sula do baba mujhe bula kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
jab aa gaye najaf se beti ko milne baba
zaano pe rakh ke sar ye kehne lagi wo dukhiya
zainab ujad gayi hai karbobala basa kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
qaimon ke saath jhoola bistar bhi jal gaya hai
namoos e mustafa ko baaghi kaha gaya hai
le jayenge subha ko qaidi hamay bana kar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
<<DIVIDER>>
guzregi kaise yawar maqtal se shaahzadi
abid ne raat momin ye soch kar guzaari
zainab ka naam lega zaalim jo muskurakar
kaisi ye shaam aayi...
author: Yawar Yusufi
